prompt.en: When Europeans explored Canada, which people were nomadic and followed the bison herd?
prompt.fr: À l'époque où les Européens ont exploré le Canada, quel peuple était nomade et suivait les troupeaux de bisons?

explanation.en: The Sioux moved with the bison rather than staying in one place. In the Northwest, the Cree and Dene lived by hunting and gathering; around the Great Lakes, the Huron-Wendat also planted crops.
explanation.fr: Les Sioux se déplaçaient avec les bisons plutôt que de rester au même endroit. Dans le Nord-Ouest, les Cris et les Dénés vivaient de la chasse et de la cueillette; autour des Grands Lacs, les Hurons-Wendat cultivaient aussi la terre.

source.quote: The Sioux were nomadic, following the bison (buffalo) herd.

verification.evidence: The Huron-Wendat of the Great Lakes region, like the Iroquois, were farmers and hunters. The Cree and Dene of the Northwest were hunter-gatherers. The Sioux were nomadic, following the bison (buffalo) herd. The Inuit lived off Arctic wildlife.
